tweet.text:
PROMPT 

Build a single-file HTML page with three.js (ES modules from a CDN, no build step):
a tornado tearing apart a floating voxel farm island, rendered as pixel art.

TITLE: "TWISTER FARM" (small, top-left), with a one-line subtitle.

RENDER STYLE - PIXEL ART
- Render the 3D scene to a low-res target (~320 px wide), upscale with nearest-neighbor
  to fill the screen. Post-process: limited palette (~40 colors: storm greys, greens,
  wheat yellows, barn reds, browns), ordered Bayer 4x4 dithering, a 1-px darker outline
  where depth changes. No smooth gradients anywhere.
- Orthographic isometric camera, slow auto-orbit. The island fills most of the frame,
  the funnel and the storm cloud fill the top.

THE ISLAND
A floating isometric island with chunky dirt boulders hanging underneath. Patchwork
farmland: a wheat field, crop rows, a plowed field, grass, a small pond, a wooden fence
along the edges, a few voxel trees, a red barn with white trim, a grey silo, and a white
farmhouse with a red roof.

THE TORNADO (hero element)
- A tall rotating funnel from the ground to a swirling dark storm cloud deck above
  the island. Built from thousands of small cubes in spiral bands, narrow at the bottom,
  wide at the top, with a slight rope-like bend. A brown dust skirt swirls at its base.
- It slowly travels across the island.

ACTION - it is already happening at frame 0, no intro, no calm start, no camera fly-in:
- Debris orbits the funnel on rising spirals: barn boards, hay bales, fence posts,
  chunks of dirt and grass, chickens, cows (voxel, black and white), a green tractor.
- The barn roof peels off board by board and streams into the funnel.
- At ~5 s the whole farmhouse lifts off its foundation and spins up the funnel, tumbling;
  only the stone foundation is left on the ground.
- The ground near the funnel is ripped out cube by cube, leaving holes in the island.
- Crops, grass and trees bend toward the funnel; leaves get pulled in.
- Lightning strikes from the cloud every few seconds: a jagged bolt plus a full-scene flash.
- Diagonal rain streaks.
- By the end (~20 s) the island is visibly stripped: barn gone, fields torn up.
  Then the tornado thins out and lifts back into the cloud, and debris rains down.

UI (minimal, must not cover the scene): the title top-left; a small panel on the right
with toggles: wind strength, lightning on/off, day/storm lighting, reset.

All physics must look plausible: debris speed increases closer to the funnel, objects
rotate as they orbit, nothing passes through the island. 60 fps, everything in one file.
